text:
- Use Task Message on your computer: open the website, scan the code with your phone, and your recent chats sync over, end-to-end encrypted.
- Schedule messages: touch and hold the send button to pick when it goes out.
- Move tasks between stages by holding a card.
- Messages and voice notes now confirm as sent right away, and chats catch up instantly when you reopen the app.
- Many other fixes and improvements.
